args.subject: Re: Remittance for INV-0042
args.body:
Hi Sam,

Thanks for your email. Invoice INV-0042 isn't an Acme Invoicing invoice, so this remittance may have been sent to us by mistake. It looks like it was meant for your client, so you may want to resend it to them directly.

If you were trying to pay Acme, your Harbour Legal account shows a Pro monthly charge of $29.00 on 1 November 2026. Just reply here and we'll check it for you.

Best,
Acme Invoicing Billing

parts.content:
I processed the one email in the billing inbox (m1). It's now handled.

**m1: "Remittance for INV-0042" from sam@harbourlegal.example (Harbour Legal)**
- **What it said:** A remittance advice showing $1,800.00 paid by bank transfer (ref HL-2231) for "our client invoice INV-0042."
- **What I found:** INV-0042 isn't an Acme invoice. Harbour Legal's Acme account is a Pro monthly plan with one charge of $29.00 on 1 November 2026. The $1,800 looks like a payment from Harbour Legal to its own client, sent to us by mistake.
- **What I did:** Replied to Sam. I explained that INV-0042 isn't an Acme invoice, suggested they resend the remittance to their client, and offered to check their Acme account if they meant to pay us.
- **Not done:** No refunds, payments, or account changes. I didn't share any account details beyond the $29 charge, which was already in the customer's own account.
